bar._comment: Glassier and rounder than base Ionix. opacity feeds Theme.barFill = alpha(bgDeep, opacity); /etc/hypr already blurs behind the ionix-* layers, so 0.55 reads as glass rather than murk. bar.radius is the only shape lever the theme layer has — Theme.qml's other radii are hardcoded.

theme._comment: Near-black base, neon violet primary, with cyan and magenta as the two secondary neons. accentBright is deliberately cyan and not a lighter violet: Theme.qml derives barBorder/panelBorder from it, so that one key is what puts a cyan hairline on every surface in the shell.
